label: LoadMsg:All02md
en: Operation: Hollywood and Vain - Location: Los Angeles, California

label: LoadBrief:All02md
en:
Objective 1: Destroy all Grinders in the city 
 Objective 2: Destroy all Yuri buildings 
 
 Hint: Not all civilians have been mind controlled. Some of them may even be able to help us in the coming battle

label: BRIEF:ALL02MD
en:
Yuri has mind controlled the population of Los Angeles and is feeding the civilians into his Grinders to fund his Psychic Dominator project. If we can eliminate the Grinders, Yuri will have lost a significant source of funds. 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy all Grinders in the city 
 Objective 2: Destroy all Yuri buildings 
 
 Hint: Not all civilians have been mind controlled. Some of them may even be able to help us in the coming battle

label: MISSION:Grinders
en: Objective: Destroy all Grinders in the city

label: MISSION:LAX
en: Hint: Capture LAX to gain access to paratroopers

label: MISSION:Money
en: Hint: We may be able to salvage funds from Yuri's Grinders when they are destroyed.

label: MISSION:Heroes
en: Hint: Action Heroes are excellent against infantry. Use them to eliminate Yuri Clones

label: LoadMsg:All03md
en: Operation: Power Play - Location: Seattle, Washington

label: LoadBrief:All03md
en:
Objective 1: Destroy Yuri's Nuclear Silo 
 Objective 2: Liberate the MassiveSoft campus

label: BRIEF:ALL03MD
en:
Now that we've destroyed Yuri's primary source of funds, the madman has decided to take a more direct approach. Yuri has set up a Nuclear Silo in Seattle and is using it to extort money and technical expertise from the MassiveSoft corporation. We must save the city and MassiveSoft from Yuri's nuclear threat. 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy Yuri's Nuclear Silo 
 Objective 2: Liberate the MassiveSoft campus

label: MISSION:RescueMS
en: Secondary Objective: Liberate the MassiveSoft Campus from Yuri's goons

label: MISSION:RescueEinstein
en: Objective: Rescue Einstein from Yuri's secret base near the Great Pyramid

label: MISSION:DestroyYuri04A
en: Objective: Destroy Yuri's main base in the East

label: MISSION:DerrickHint
en: Hint: Send engineers into the oil derricks in the East to increase cash flow

label: Brief:All04md
en:
Yuri has captured Einstein in an attempt to expedite the completion of his Psychic Dominator Technology. It is imperative we rescue Einstein immediately and then rid Egypt of all Yuri forces. 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy Bio Reactors around Great Pyramid to rescue Einstein. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Yuri's Base.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll04md
en: With your speed and accuracy Einstein was rescued and Yuri's installation is no more. Yuri realizes now you're a force to be reckoned with.

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll04md
en: You rescued Einstein but Yuri was able to withdraw key forces before his base was destroyed.

label: LoadMsg:All05md
en: Operation: Clones Down Under - Location: Sydney, Australia

label: MISSION:BoomerAttack
en: WARNING - Yuri is sending Boomer subs our way! Prepare for confrontation!

label: MISSION:DestroyCloning
en: Objective: Destroy Yuri's Cloning facility in the South

label: Brief:All05md
en:
Yuri has established cloning facilities in Sydney, Australia. It is believed he plans to clone the world leaders. We must put an end to this operation at any cost. 
 
 Objective 1: Find and destroy Yuri's Cloning Vats. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Yuri's remaining forces.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll05md
en: Yuri's cloning facilities are now rubble thanks to your incredible tactics. Well done!

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll05md
en: You have destroyed Yuri's cloning facilities, but the long battle has left Sydney devastated.

label: LoadBrief:All07md
en:
Objective 1: Build a Soviet Radar Dish 
 Objective 2: Destroy the Psychic Dominator in Antarctica 
 Objective 3: Destroy all Yuri forces

label: BRIEF:ALL07MD
en:
It's almost over, Commander. Yuri's plot lies in ruins. However, he still has one last Psychic Dominator located somewhere in his stronghold in Antarctica. Bring the abandoned Soviet Base on Tierra del Fuego back online and build a radar dish so that we can pinpoint Yuri's exact location. Then, with the combined might of Allied and Soviet forces, put an end to Yuri's plans once and for all. 
 
 Objective 1: Build a Soviet Radar Dish 
 Objective 2: Destroy the Psychic Dominator in Antarctica 
 Objective 3: Destroy all Yuri forces

label: MISSION:Fuego
en: Objective: Use engineers to bring the Soviet base back online

label: MISSION:Radar
en: Objective: Build a Soviet Radar Dish

label: MISSION:KillPD
en: Objective: Destroy the Psychic Dominator on Antarctica

label: LoadMsg:Sov04md
en: Operation: Romanov on the Run - Location: Morocco

label: MISSION:FindRomanov
en: Objective: Locate Premier Romanov before Yuri's troops do

label: MISSION:RecoverRomanov
en: Objective: Rescue Romanov from Yuri's control

label: MISSION:DestroyYuri04S
en: Objective: Destroy Yuri's base around the airport so Romanov can be safely evacuated

label: MISSION:TakeRomanov
en: Objective: Take Romanov to the airport where he can be transported away safely

label: Brief:Sov04md
en:
Premier Romanov has been shot down by Yuri's forces. We must locate the Premier and take him to the airport so he can be rescued. Yuri has built a tough defense around the airport that we need to eliminate before the Premier's rescue will be secure. 
 
 Objective 1: Locate Premier Romanov and protect him. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Yuri's base guarding the airport. 
 Objective 3: Take Romanov to the airport once it is safe.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov04md
en: Premier Romanov has been rescued and safely evacuated thanks to your quick and decisive elimination of Yuri's base.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov04md
en: Premier Romanov has been rescued and safely evacuated but he is not happy. It took too long for you to rescue him.

label: LoadMsg:Sov06md
en: Operation: To the Moon - Location: The Moon

label: MISSION:BuildBase
en: Objective: Find a location to set up base

label: MISSION:DestroyLunarCommand
en: Objective: Locate and destroy Yuri's Lunar Command Center

label: MISSION:DestroyYuri06S
en: Objective: Destroy all remaining Yuri buildings

label: Brief:Sov06md
en:
Yuri plans to launch himself to the moon after initiating his Psychic Dominator wave over earth. We need to install a base on the moon so we can build an attack force capable of destroying Yuri's moon bases and his Lunar Command Center. 
 
 Objective 1: Find a location to build a base. 
 Objective 2: Locate and Destroy Yuri's Lunar Command Center. 
 Objective 3: Destroy Yuri's remaining base.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov06md
en: You moved so quickly that Yuri couldn't do anything but watch his lunar establishment crumble. The moon is now a part of the glorious Soviet state.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov06md
en: Yuri's lunar base has been destroyed. Congratulations, General.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll02md
en: Great job, Commander. Your quick actions minimized civilian losses in the city and denied Yuri an important source of income to fund his plans. Hollywood agents are already offering deals for the rights to your life story.

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll02md
en: Yuri has lost an important source of funds, but not without exacting a heavy price on the civilian population of Los Angeles.

label: MISSION:NukeHint
en: HINT: Yuri also relies on Power Plants for his Nuclear Silo

label: MISSION:PowerAtk
en: WARNING - Our Power Plants are under attack!

label: MISSION:Virus
en: Hint: Snipers have a longer range than the Virus

label: MISSION:Virus2
en: Hint: The Virus has a longer range than Snipers

label: MISSION:Cloud
en: WARNING - Infantry will take damage if standing within a Virus cloud

label: MISSION:LowPower
en: Capture Power Plants to bring the Weather Control Device online

label: MISSION:Needle
en: Hint: Garrison the Space Needle to survey the area

label: MISSION:YuriMove
en: WARNING - Yuri is attempting to engineer our Power Plants

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll03md
en: Yuri's plot to blackmail the city of Seattle has been thwarted. Your lightning-fast response prevented heavy losses to the population. Yuri will have to look elsewhere to fund his war effort.

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll03md
en: Though Yuri has been driven from Seattle, the city paid a heavy price for your victory. Much of Seattle now lies in radioactive ruins, and the software market has been thrown into disarray.

label: LoadMsg:All06md
en: Operation: Trick or Treaty - Location: London, England

label: LoadBrief:All06md
en:
Objective 1: Defend Parliament from assault. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Yuri's Base.

label: Brief:All06md
en:
Having failed to clone the world leaders, Yuri plans to capture the real ones. Defend them at the Houses of Parliament in London, England...then deal with Yuri. 
 
 Objective 1: Defend Parliament from assault. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Yuri's Base.

label: MISSION:ParlHint
en: Hint: Repair Parliament with an Engineer

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll06md
en: Yuri never had a chance. The world leaders are safe and Yuri has been driven from London. Excellent work, General.

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll06md
en: The day is won...but at what cost? The world leaders feared for their lives during the battle and fled at first chance. The treaty holds...for now.

label: MISSION:MixUnits
en: Hint: Combine Soviet infantry with our IFV's for more powerful units

label: MISSION:PDHint
en: Hint: Spread our units out so that the Psychic Dominator won't be able to mind control large masses of our forces.

label: MISSION:GMHint
en: Hint: Spread out our infantry so that Yuri will not be able to use the Genetic Mutator on large groups of units.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgAll07md
en: The whole world now knows your true brilliance as a commander. Your image is appearing on stamps in every nation across the globe, and a worldwide holiday has been declared in your honor.

label: GUI:OverParMsgAll07md
en: The world will never know just how close it came to complete destruction. Let's hope we got every last one of Yuri's clones.

label: LoadBrief:Sov01md
en:
Objective 1: Destroy the Allied Navy and Grand Cannons. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Pill Boxes around Time Machine to capture it. 
 Objective 3: Capture 4 Power Plants to Power Time Machine. 
 Objective 4: Take Control of Soviet Base and use it to Destroy the Psychic Dominator.

label: Brief:Sov01md
en:
The world is in ruin. Yuri is poised to rule unchallenged. Only a daring Allied plan to travel back in time stands between Yuri and total domination. But Yuri must pay for his betrayal at Soviet hands, not Allied. We must capture the Time Machine and travel back ourselves. 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy the Allied Navy and Grand Cannons. 
 Objective 2: Destroy Pill Boxes around Time Machine to capture it. 
 Objective 3: Capture 4 Power Plants to Power Time Machine. 
 Objective 4: Take Control of Soviet Base and use it to Destroy the Psychic Dominator.

label: MISSION:RexyHelp
en: Rexy is trapped! Won't you help him?

label: MISSION:RexyFrnd
en: Rexy is now your friend to the end!

en: WARNING - Critical structure. Do not destroy!!!

en: More of our troops have arrived on the beach

label: MISSION:MoreEngn
en: Engineers have arrived near the Time Machine

en: Yuri is trying to capture the Power Plants!

label: MISSION:HintPowr
en: Hint: Capture Power Plants with Engineers

label: MISSION:DomArmed
en: The Psychic Dominator is now armed!!!

label: MISSION:HintDom
en: Hint: Capturing Power Plants will stop the Psychic Dominator

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov01md
en: You have destroyed the Psychic Dominator before Yuri could react. Yuri does not yet realize our plans.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov01md
en: The Psychic Dominator has been destroyed...but Yuri is now aware of our plans.

label: LoadMsg:Sov03md
en: Operation: Brain Wash - Location: London, England

label: LoadBrief:Sov03md
en:
Objective 1: Destroy the Psychic Beacon. 
 Objective 2: Destroy the Psychic Dominator. 
 Objective 3: Finish off Yuri's forces.

label: Brief:Sov03md
en:
The Allies have discovered a Psychic Dominator in London, England. Yuri has taken control of the Allied strike force to help defend his near-complete Dominator. Free the Allies and join forces with them to defeat Yuri...but beware, the Dominator could become operational at any moment. 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy the Psychic Beacon. 
 Objective 2: Destroy the Psychic Dominator. 
 Objective 3: Finish off Yuri's forces.

label: MISSION:WarnArmd
en: WARNING - The Psychic Dominator is Armed!!!

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov03md
en: The Psychic Dominator has been destroyed and the Allies believe we fought for a common good. Fools.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov03md
en: This Psychic Dominator has been neutralized, but I doubt the Allies will ever help us again.

Objective 1: Pick a landing zone and construct a base.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov05md
en: Your swift attack will keep this secret island a secret forever. Yuri's forces are in full retreat. Press on, General--Defeat Yuri!

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov05md
en: Yuri's submarines are no longer a threat, but your lengthy siege has given Yuri ample time to form another devious plan.

label: Brief:Sov07md
en:
Hoping to hide from your onslaught, Yuri has retreated to his ancestral home in Transylvania. We can not allow him any respite or he will only rally his forces and return again to threaten us all. Eliminate Yuri now and forever! 
 
 Objective 1: Destroy Yuri's Fortress.

label: GUI:UnderParMsgSov07md
en: The sheer ferocity of your attack and genius of your tactics left Yuri stunned. There is no doubt you have crushed him once and for all.

label: GUI:OverParMsgSov07md
en: Though the battle was long, you have finally rid the world of Yuri.
